advice.text: Rear-limited corners: rear ARB/springs softer; on throttle (phase 4) accel diff lock -10%.
advice.evidence: 6/15 corners red on the rears (0 on exit)

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 16.85; 5/5 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 0.46 / R 0.91; 3/5 stops locked both

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.353 over 15 corners (9 understeer, 1 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Trail-brake understeer: finish more braking before steering; caster +0.5 for camber-in-turn.
advice.evidence: 4/15 corners red on the fronts at turn-in

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 293 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Mixed axle signal — 7 front-limited vs 6 rear-limited of 15 corners. Not enough agreement for a balance call: repeat the same corner type several times before changing anything.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.67) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
